title: Demo arm (demo_update.gleam) does NOT route through notification_target_path; its inline navigation path is unpinned and vacancy-typed demo clicks still no-op
detail: Round-2 hard blocker class requires BOTH arms route through the pure notification_target_path/3 helper with tests pinning it. grep confirms notification_target_path is referenced only in client.gleam (4399, 6929) and tests — demo_update duplicates the path construction inline, handles only "application" (vacancy-typed falls into `_, _ -> effect.none()`), and no test pins that inline string: editing it fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Route the demo arm through client.notification_target_path(model, entity_type, entity_id) and extend demo_flow_test to assert the helper's result for the demo model (vacancy + application + unknown), so a wrong demo target path fails a test.

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding untested (still present since round 1)
detail: r1 warning: pb-28 is pinned only for application_detail (client_test.gleam:5126-5151, application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test). grep of client/test for pb-28 finds only that test — a revert on vacancy_detail still goes uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids non-empty and absent when empty, mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test.

title: Filter pill shrink-0 change has no test (still present since round 1)
detail: r1 warning: the only shrink-0 pin in client/test is the status-stepper test (client_test.gleam:5115-5119); no leaderboard_view render test asserts the filter pills carry shrink-0, so a revert of the chip-truncation fix fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view render test asserting the filter pill buttons carry the shrink-0 class.

title: leaderboard_vacancy_id set-sites (fetch/refresh/navigation transitions) not directly pinned
detail: The B1 fix semantics are pinned via resolve_application_vacancy_refuses_stale_leaderboard_test (tag A + route B -> None), but no test drives AppRequestedLeaderboard/handle_browser_change to assert the tag is actually set on each transition; a dropped assignment at one of the four set-sites fails no test.
recommended_fix: Optional: one update-level test asserting leaderboard_vacancy_id == Some(id) after a leaderboard request/response round-trip.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 (notification deep-link hard-blocker class) is not 100%: real-arm pins are FULL (notification_target_path asserts exact paths for vacancy /vacancies/v1, application /vacancies/v-maples/applications/a-aoife, unknown, None; stale-leaderboard B1 repro pinned), but the demo arm does not route through the helper and its navigation path is unpinned (demo test pins only resolver + mark-read/close) -> P0 <100% triggers FAIL. P1: stepper rail, demo banner 44px, application_detail pb-28 FULL; vacancy_detail pb-28 and filter-pill shrink-0 NONE (both carried from r1).
